26566.d: The village of Taverley lies to the north-west of Falador and is the westernmost province of the kingdom of Asgarnia.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Walk south from Burthorpe.
• If the Taverley lodestone has been activated, a player may teleport there via the Home Teleport spell.
• Taverley may also be reached via the balloon transport system. This provides ready access to Taverley from Varrock (by the earth altar), Entrana (west side of the island), Crafting Guild, Castle Wars (to the east & north), or from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Reaching Taverley requires 1 set of logs after unlocking the route.
• If a player's player-owned house is in Taverley they can teleport there with House Teleport. If the Love Story quest has been completed, players can use a Taverley tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to house tablet) to teleport to the Taverley house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.

26567.d: Taverley is a town to the north-west of Falador and is the westernmost part of the kingdom of Asgarnia.

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
• To the north lies Burthorpe and Death Plateau
• To the south-east lies Falador - players can get there either by climbing over the crumbling wall (5 agility required) or via the gate to the north-east of Taverley
• To the west lies White Wolf Mountain, which can be dangerous for new players to cross, and beyond lies Catherby - players who have completed the Fishing Contest quest can use the tunnel to the north-west of Taverley to go under rather than over White Wolf Mountain
• Taverley may also be reached via the balloon transport system. This provides ready access to Taverley from Varrock (by the Earth altar), Entrana (west side of the island), Crafting Guild, Castle Wars (to the east & north), or from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Note to reach Taverley requires 1 set of logs after unlocking the route.
• If a player's Player-owned house is in Taverley they can teleport there with House Teleport. If the Love Story quest has been completed, players can use a Taverley tablet (made from a chipped teleport to house tablet) to teleport to the Taverley house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.

26573.d: The Taverley Dungeon is the one of the largest dungeons in RuneScape, surpassed by Brimhaven Dungeon, the Chaos Tunnels and God Wars Dungeon.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The entrance to the dungeon is found south of Taverley and west of Falador. After the update Troll Warzone, it was relocated closer to a bank - directly south of the dock past the bridge by the wheat patch. (The boat carries to Daemonheim, and from there to Al Kharid or back to Taverley).

The Obelisk of Water on an island can only be reached by traversing the dungeon. The island is just off the coast near Catherby. There is a one-way mithril grapple shortcut from the island to the shore which requires 36 Agility, 39 Ranged, and 22 Strength.

26697.d: The Temple Knight HQ is the main headquarters of the Temple Knights, a group of Saradomin servants dedicated to defeating any threat to Saradomin.

26698.d: The Temple of Amascut is now ruins with only a broken monument face of Amascut remaining.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Teleport to fairy ring BIQ and run south-west.
• Rub an amulet of glory and teleport to Al Kharid (option 4), exit Shantay Pass to the south, then run south-west.
• Teleport to the Al Kharid lodestone, run south-east to Shantay Pass, exit to the south, then run south-west.

26699.d: The Temple of Aminishi, also known as ED1 or the Temple of Seiryu, is the first Elite Dungeon, a 1-3 player combat/narrative experience that rewards unique loot and Dungeoneering experience and dungeoneering tokens.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Complete the quest Impressing the Locals to access the dungeon.
• Teleport to Port Sarim and travel to the island of Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully. Run to the main gate of the Temple of Aminishi to the north.
• Use the Arc journal to teleport to the island of Aminishi and run to the Temple of Aminishi gate.
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat (requires at least one boss kill from the dungeon).
• Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
• Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
• Use the Dungeoneering master cape to teleport to the entrance to Daemonheim Peninsula Island, and then run north to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
• Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside the Shadow Reef, the Dragonkin Laboratory, or the Zamorakian Undercity.
